text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My instructor had to cancel our five
o'clock
French lesson tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Six thirty is my tea ceremony lesson,
followed by
a social gathering from
eight o'clock...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Many well-known individuals from the
financial
world will be present... So I
should use my spare
time until the tea
lesson to brush up on the
economy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I must present myself well so as not to
embarrass
my family.
